supersedes.reason: A pre-inference leakage audit found source sessions and gold evidence timestamped after question_date. The v1 file is retained unchanged as provenance.

dataset.eligibility_rule: exclude the entire question if any gold evidence session is after question_date; otherwise omit every non-gold session after question_date
dataset.official_500_case_comparability_note: The leakage-safe result is not directly comparable to official runs that expose all 500 complete histories. No future-evidence 500-case result will be presented as primary.

primary_quality_comparison.metric: official-protocol per-question LongMemEval QA correctness on all 456 leakage-safe eligible questions
primary_quality_comparison.decision_rule: noninferior only if the lower endpoint of the two-sided 95% paired-bootstrap confidence interval is greater than -0.03

cost_condition.metric: counterfactual standalone complete-system variable cost, excluding evaluator
cost_condition.decision_rule: the quality-cost claim succeeds only if C is noninferior to B and C costs at least 10% less than B
cost_condition.shared_artifacts: physically cached common work is charged in full to every arm for standalone attribution
